in_marathi.name: Udeep
in_marathi.long_meaning: Udeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘udakam’ which means ‘water’ or ‘ocean’. In Hindu mythology, Udeep is believed to symbolize the deep ocean and its vastness. This name is bestowed upon a boy, reflecting the deep and vast potential he holds within himself.
